auditPolicy.activationRule: A city is ready only when every visible plate has a unique human place name and every resolution targets exhaustive exact source IDs.
auditPolicy.exactIdRule: Every ambiguous, numbered, directional or operational IRIS is explicitly accepted, renamed or merged by exact source ID.
auditPolicy.acceptRule: Accept is reserved for a real official human local name and records the dated Guide Alpha decision.
auditPolicy.renameRule: Rename requires official IGN BD TOPO evidence strictly inside the exact source IRIS. Nearest-point assignment is forbidden.
auditPolicy.mergeRule: Merge requires one semantic source family and a connected official polygon graph proven from shared boundary vertices.
auditPolicy.geometryAdjacency: Connected merge families are verified from official WFS boundary vertices rounded to eight decimal places.
auditPolicy.strictToponymRule: Every rename records an official IGN coordinate strictly inside the exact IRIS and strictContainmentVerified=true.
